title: PermissionSetGroup - Data API
description: Represents a group of permission sets and the permissions within them. Use permission set groups to organize permissions based on job functions or tasks. Then, you can package the groups as needed. This object is available in API version 45.0 and later.

Description.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

DeveloperName.description: The permission set group name used in the API.

HasActivationRequired.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
HasActivationRequired.description: Indicates whether the permission set group requires an associated active session (true) or not (false). The default value is false. This field is available in API version 53.0 and later.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Language.description: The Permission Set Group language. Possible values are: da (Danish) de (German) en_US (English) es (Spanish) es_MX (Spanish - Mexican) fi (Finnish) fr (French) it (Italian) ja (Japanese) ko (Korean) nl_NL (Dutch) no (Norwegian) pt_BR (Portuguese - Brazilian) ru (Russian) sv (Swedish) th (Thai) zh_CN (Chinese - Simplified) zh_TW (Chinese - Traditional)

MasterLabel.description: The permission set group label for the aggregated permissions.

NamespacePrefix.description: The permission set group namespace prefix.

Status.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
Status.description: Indicates permission set group recalculation status. Updated. The group is current. Outdated. The group requires recalculation. Updating. The group is in recalculation mode. Failed. The group recalculation failed.
